_comment: Chain of command. Every formation is led by a commander with hidden TRAITS. The player learns them only when
they show: a refusal, or the commander's first week in battle (the SITREP carries a staff assessment).
Trait effects: refuse_unsupported_assault = chance to refuse an ASSAULT order when no artillery, air superiority
or naval gunfire supports the formation; refuse_withdraw = chance to refuse a WITHDRAW order; attack_bonus /
defense_bonus = firepower in ASSAULT / defense in DEFEND; casualties_taken multiplies losses; supply_consumption
multiplies weekly supply use and resupply_bonus raises what the depots push forward each week.
orbat: traits of the starting commanders (names as in orbat.json). Anyone not listed rolls random traits from
trait_weights. pool: replacement generals for relieved commanders and newly raised formations.
relieve: cost of firing a general (military morale of the nation, morale of the formation).
